From soulful melodies to upbeat tracks, the soundtrack of Rehnaa Hai Terre Dil Mein continues to hold a special place in Bollywood music lovers’ hearts. Sung by Sonu Nigam, “Oh Mama Mama” brings a playful, youthful energy to the film’s unforgettable musical collection.

Released in 2001, RHTDM’s music continues to evoke memories of romance, friendship and first love, even after 25 years.

Which RHTDM song is your all-time favourite?

(SCREEN, Rehnaa Hai Terre Dil Mein, RHTDM, Oh Mama Mama, Sonu Nigam)".

1,252 likes, 36 comments - hercircleofficial on October 16, 2026: "Dia Mirza has spent years championing sustainability, bringing environmental advocacy into the mainstream and making conscious living part of the conversation. The roots of that commitment go back to her childhood in Hyderabad, where nature was part of her education, solar energy was being explored at home, and repairing things was a point of pride.

In conversation with Tanya Chaitanya for 𝘏𝘦𝘳 𝘊𝘪𝘳𝘤𝘭𝘦 𝘖𝘳𝘪𝘨𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴, Dia looks back at the experiences that shaped her environmental consciousness and shares how those values inform her life today, from mindful purchases for her son to the way she travels. It’s a perspective on sustainability shaped by years of advocacy, personal conviction and the lessons from childhood that continue to stay with us. 

Credits

CEO & Editor-in-Chief: Tanya Chaitanya @tanyachaitanya27

Head - Marketing & Comms: Iona Chatterjee @ionachatterjee

Art Director & Video Editor: Sameer More @sambeingg

Videographer: Harish Iyer @iyerishh

Assistant Videographer: Yash Bedi @yashu.bedi_

On-location Support: Nikita Bajaj @missbajaj_25

#HerCircleOriginals #HerCircle #HerCircleCommunity #DiaMirza #SustainableLife".

1,201 likes, 34 comments - hercircleofficial on October 15, 2026: "What does it take to make space for yourself in a world that expects you to keep showing up? And how much do the values we grow up with shape the choices we make as adults?

For Dia Mirza Rekhi, the answers lie in the experiences that have shaped her perspective. From renegotiating the terms of her work after a life-changing encounter with a forest to growing up with a mother and a grandmother who embodied independence, generosity and equality, Dia reflects on the moments that continue to guide her. 

In conversation with Tanya Chaitanya for 𝘏𝘦𝘳 𝘊𝘪𝘳𝘤𝘭𝘦 𝘖𝘳𝘪𝘨𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘭𝘴, she speaks about finding balance, navigating the expectations placed on women and recognising the values that stay with us long after childhood.

To watch the full interview, visit Hercircle.in

24K likes, 713 comments - diamirzaofficial on October 11, 2026: "The right to peaceful protest in India is guaranteed under Article 19 of the Indian Constitution, specifically through Article 19(1)(a) and Article 19(1)(b):
• Article 19(1)(a) – Guarantees the freedom of speech and expression, which includes the right to express dissent, voice opinions, and criticize government actions.
• Article 19(1)(b) – Guarantees the right to assemble peaceably and without arms, allowing citizens to hold public meetings, demonstrations, and peaceful processions.
• Article 19(1)(c) – Guarantees the right to form associations or unions, which supports collective protest movements and labor organizing.

Jai Hind 🇮🇳".
